response.rationale: The order is still in transit (status: in_transit) and has not been delivered, so days_since_delivery is null. The standard return window rules (RET-007/RET-008) key off days since delivery, which cannot be evaluated as satisfied because delivery has not occurred. Category is 'home', not 'electronics', so RET-002/RET-003 do not apply. Defective is null (unconfirmed), so RET-020 does not apply. Final_sale is false, no goodwill grant, and no fraud hold, so none of those rules apply either. With no delivery yet, no return-eligibility rule is satisfied, so the request cannot be granted as a return at this time.
